about: The example project behind 'Open example project' (first-run plan, step 1). Invented product and company. English is the original; 'languages' holds the prepared translations, keyed by base language code (pt-BR and zh-Hans where variants differ). Inline markup in the text: **bold**, *italic*, [link text](url). tools\example_project\build_example_docs.py turns 'document' into one Word file per language.

document.text: The *AL-50* is intended for domestic use only.
Read this guide carefully before you install or use the appliance, and keep it for future reference.

items.text: Disconnect the appliance from the mains before opening the cover.
**Warning:** The appliance must be installed by a qualified electrician.
Protect the appliance with a residual current device (RCD) with a rated residual current of 30 mA.
Do not install the appliance in a room where the temperature can fall below 0 °C.
Never operate the appliance without water.
Children must not play with the appliance.
1 water heater
1 wall bracket
3 fixing screws with wall plugs
2 sealing washers
1 installation and operating guide

document.text: The maximum water pressure is 0.6 MPa (6 bar). If the mains water pressure is higher, fit a pressure reducing valve.

items.text: Mark the positions of the holes, using the wall bracket as a template.
Drill three holes with a diameter of 6 mm and insert the wall plugs.
Fix the wall bracket to the wall with the upper fixing screw.
Hang the appliance on the wall bracket.
Tighten the two lower fixing screws with a 4 mm hex key.
Connect the cold water supply to the blue inlet.
Connect the hot water pipe to the red outlet.
Open a hot water tap until the water flows without air bubbles, then close it.
Have a qualified electrician connect the appliance to the mains.
Switch the appliance on with the **ON/OFF** button.
Turn the temperature dial clockwise to increase the water temperature.
Press **+** to raise the temperature in steps of 1 °C.
Press **–** to lower the temperature in steps of 1 °C.

document.text: The display shows the set temperature. The appliance switches off automatically if no water flows for 10 minutes.

rows.text: Open the stopcock on the cold water supply.

document.text: If the display shows E3, the inlet filter is blocked. Clean the filter as described in section 7.
Before you open the cover, read the safety instructions.
Clean the inlet filter once a year. In areas with hard water, descale the appliance every two years.
Do not dispose of the appliance with household waste.
For spare parts and service, visit [www.acme.example/service](https://www.acme.example/service) or call +1 555 0100.

tmBands: 100 = an exact match; numbers = differs only in its numbers (Studio scores it 100 and fills in the numbers, FuzzyFixer treats it as 99); fuzzy = 70-99, what FuzzyFixer repairs; low = below 70, which FuzzyFixer leaves alone. The example-project test checks each one with Studio's own fuzzy search.

tm.source: Disconnect the appliance from the mains before opening the cover.
Before you open the cover, read the safety instructions.
Connect the hot water pipe to the red outlet.
The maximum water pressure is 1.0 MPa (10 bar).
The appliance is intended for domestic use only.
Press + to change the temperature in steps of 1 °C.
Turn the temperature dial clockwise to increase the flow rate.
Tighten the upper fixing screw with a 5 mm hex key.
Do not install the appliance in a room where it can freeze.
If the display shows E2, replace the temperature sensor.
